checks.name: Native project and audio validation
checks.observed: The 32-file ZIP passed fresh import, main entry, Hyper3D and procedural character, and six-preset checks. Custom audio survives save/reopen and remains event-driven.

checks.name: Windows export launch
checks.observed: Godot 4.7.2 Windows debug export succeeded; its standalone EXE ran headlessly for 300 frames and exited. This does not qualify windowed input or rendering.

checks.name: Film decoding and audio measurement
checks.observed: All 480 frames decoded; audio peaked at -20.74 dBFS with zero clipped samples. Measurement does not replace listening judgment.

checks.name: Human audiovisual review
checks.observed: Only a model review of 54 sampled frames was completed. At 10.667–10.767 seconds, impact spokes cross a gallery label, which remains readable. Human natural-speed audiovisual review is pending.

checks.name: MCP tool bridge
checks.observed: blocked: the current bridge could not complete because of ownership_conflict; no successful MCP tool-call acceptance is claimed for this run.

checks.name: Native keyboard and mouse input
checks.observed: Ordinary keyboard and mouse acceptance was not run; scripted casting and count assertions do not replace it.

checks.name: Godot Web export and interaction
checks.observed: This candidate is limited to a film and native source; Web export and browser game interaction acceptance were not run.

checks.name: Physical-phone execution
checks.observed: No physical-phone run was performed; desktop rendering does not establish phone behavior.

checks.name: Game-scale concurrent performance
checks.observed: Frame time, GPU memory and target-device budgets for game-scale concurrent effects were not measured.

checks.name: Deployed bilingual player
checks.observed: Not deployed; playback, pause, seeking and resource downloads on deployed English or Chinese pages were not verified.
